{{Top|leg}}
The '''shocker stick''' was a device used for [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. It was a X-shaped platform that stood upright, to which the prisoner was strapped with restraints which delivered electrical shocks through restraints on the victim's [[Foot/Legends|feet]] and [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. If you abuse this torture device, however, it can result in death quickly. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Juhm]] used shocker sticks on [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], along with Anakin's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], after the four were captured during an attempt to free Juhm's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on [[Gwori]].
